## Human review verdict — chalbert/web-everything#1504

**Verdict:** ✅ pass — no blocking findings

### Panel verdicts

| lens | weight | verdict |
| --- | --- | --- |
| correctness | mandatory | accept |

### Findings (1)

**coverage** (1)
- `src/_data/backlog.js:895` — The same NaN-producing `Number(a)-Number(b)` comparator pattern this PR fixes in backlogGraph.js still lives, unfixed, in three other files that sort the identical id space (src/_data/backlog.js:895, src/assets/js/backlog-graph.js:141/147/157, src/assets/js/backlog-active.js:277). — src/assets/js/backlog-graph.js is the client-side renderer that consumes the exact `nodes`/`edges` JSON this PR's backlogGraph.js emits, and re-sorts it client-side with `Number(a[0].num) - Number(b[0].num)` (line 141) and `Number(a.num) - Number(b.num)` (lines 147, 157). The moment a hash-id item (JIT numbering, #2288) reaches these sorts — e.g. an unlanded item shows up as a standalone node or as the first node of a component — the comparator returns NaN for any pairing against it, which I confirmed reproduces the same inconsistent-comparator failure mode this PR fixes (verified by mutation-testing the analogous compareNodes/compareEdges in backlogGraph.js: reverting them to `Number(a.num)-Number(b.num)` reddens the new 'the node and edge sorts BOTH use that total order' test with a visibly scrambled order). backlog.js:895 (`byNumAsc`, used to sort the active-work lanes) and backlog-active.js:277 (`numCmp`) have the identical shape and are reachable by any hash-id item with status 'active'. Net effect downstream: implementation-defined, potentially run-to-run-unstable ordering of lane items and SVG node/component layout — a visible but non-destructive rendering inconsistency, not data loss. No test in the repo guards any of these four call sites today. _[CONFIRMED]_ _[impact if unfixed: degraded]_
  - _Prevention (OWED — file it):_ Promote compareIds (and compareNodes/compareEdges as needed) to a small shared module the other three call sites import instead of re-deriving `Number(a)-Number(b)`, and add a grep-based check:standards rule that flags `Number(` used directly inside an `Array.prototype.sort` comparator anywhere in src/, forcing new/existing call sites onto the shared primitive.

---

**Decision:** `accept` — recorded by operator.
**Lens:** `correctness` — a SINGLE-LENS run. One `judge` step, one juror, one lens; the table above lists only the lens that judged. The other 3 panel lenses (security, simplicity, standards-conformance) did NOT run and are not reported as unjudged.
Net basis: `c71344b816817950ca98575f5406086c2676fd4c..3b7a2e0bd42ac486825386edd96957a86aaeaf99` (rev `origin/lane/backlog-graph-total-order` at review time) — 2 net changed file(s) vs current main (#2450), not `gh pr diff`'s three-dot list.
